title: Bündner Nusstorte
hookLine: Viral Swiss bündner nusstorte crafted for mobile Cook Mode & 1-tap Story sharing.

items.name: Cake or all-purpose flour + baking powder
Toasted chopped pecans, almonds, or hazelnuts

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {eu151_flr}, {eu151_sug}, and {eu151_but} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Mix Batter & Bake Until Springy
steps.instructionTemplate: Cream {eu151_but} and {eu151_sug}, beat in {eu151_egg}, and fold in {eu151_flr}. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 30 mins until a toothpick comes out clean.

steps.title: Bake Bündner Nusstorte & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 30 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Cool Completely & Crown with Filling
steps.instructionTemplate: Cool sponge 20 minutes, then layer or glaze generously with {eu151_flv}. Let Bündner Nusstorte cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 10 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.creatorSecret: Frosting a warm cake melts buttercream—wait until the pan feels cool to the touch.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero-fluff steps + Cook Mode timer nailed it on the first batch!
